import django

from django import forms
from django.contrib.postgres.forms.array import SplitArrayField, SplitArrayWidget


def checked_states(widget, value, attrs=None):
    context = widget.get_context('array', value, attrs)
    return [
        subwidget['attrs'].get('checked', False)
        for subwidget in context['widget']['subwidgets']
    ]


cases = [
    ([True, False, True, False], None, 4, [True, False, True, False]),
    ([False, True, False, True], {'id': 'array_id', 'class': 'x'}, 4,
     [False, True, False, True]),
    ([], None, 3, [False, False, False]),
    ([True], {'id': 'array_id'}, 3, [True, False, False]),
]
for value, attrs, size, expected in cases:
    original_attrs = None if attrs is None else attrs.copy()
    widget = SplitArrayWidget(forms.CheckboxInput(), size=size)
    actual = checked_states(widget, value, attrs)
    assert actual == expected, (value, attrs, actual, expected)
    assert attrs == original_attrs, ('attrs mutated', attrs, original_attrs)
    print('state case OK:', value, attrs, actual)

# Reusing the same widget must not leak state from one render to the next.
widget = SplitArrayWidget(forms.CheckboxInput(), size=4)
assert checked_states(widget, [True, False, True, False]) == [True, False, True, False]
assert checked_states(widget, [False, True, False, True]) == [False, True, False, True]
print('reused widget OK')
